BiblicalUsage: tsᵉlâʼ is the ordinary word for pray. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Ezra 6:10 and Daniel 6:10.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsᵉlâʼ is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
